name: Aventus Spirit - Inspired by Creed Aventus | Premium Luxury Perfume for Men
description: Aventus Spirit, inspired by the prestigious Creed Aventus, embodies strength, success, and sophistication. It opens with a bright and invigorating blend of bergamot, pineapple, and black currant, capturing confidence and ambition. As it evolves, the fragrance reveals a heart of birch, patchouli, and jasmine, which add complexity and depth. The base unfolds with musk, oakmoss, ambergris, and vanilla, leaving a lasting, unforgettable trail. Crafted with the utmost care and a 40-50% perfume oil concentration, Aventus Spirit offers exceptional longevity and projection. Whether you're in the boardroom or at a special event, this fragrance ensures you leave a powerful, elegant impression. Features Top Notes: Bergamot, Pineapple, Black Currant Heart Notes: Birch, Patchouli, Jasmine Base Notes: Musk, Oakmoss, Ambergris, Vanilla Longevity: 8-12 hours (Extremely Long-Lasting) Occasion: Ideal for formal events, evening wear, or special celebrations Why Choose Aventus Spirit? Inspired by the iconic Creed Aventus Crafted with a 40-50% perfume oil concentration for premium quality A luxurious blend of bold, sophisticated notes that stand out Exclusively available at Scents by Aamir in Pakistan Materials & Care Content: Alcohol-based perfume with premium natural oils Care: Store in a cool, dry place, away from direct sunlight, to preserve its rich scent Packaging: Comes in a sleek, premium glass bottle, ideal for travel and display
